children: iA Financial Corporation Inc. (TSX: IAG) announces that it has completed today the redemption of all of its 3.072% Subordinated Debentures due September 24, 2031 (the “

”) by payment of a redemption amount of $1,015.36 for each $1,000 principal amount of Debentures, being equal to par, together with accrued and unpaid interest thereon to but excluding the date set for redemption in the amount of $15.36.

iA Financial Group is one of the largest insurance and wealth management groups in Canada, with operations in the United States. Founded in 1892, it is an important Canadian public company and is listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol IAG (common shares).
